title: The Ra Contact - Volume 1
author: Unknown
description: The Ra Contact: Teaching the Law of One, Volume 1 (L/L Research, 2018), the definitive edition of the 'Law of One' channelling sessions recorded between 1981 and 1984. The source identifies itself as Ra, 'an humble messenger of the Law of One', a sixth-density social memory complex, speaking through the entranced instrument Carla L. Rueckert in answer to questions from Don Elkins, with Jim McCarty as scribe. Re-transcribed from the original audio by Tobey Wheelock's relistening project and edited by Gary Bean and Austin Bridges, this volume covers the early sessions. Topics include the unity of all creation in the One Infinite Creator, the densities of consciousness and the harvest, the paths of service-to-others and service-to-self, the energy centres, wanderers, healing, and Ra's account of its involvement in Egypt and the pyramids. It is the core text of a large modern esoteric and UFO-related spiritual movement.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection.
rights: From the curator's private collection. Publication rights for this edition are to be confirmed before public release.
